title: Try the adoption guide on different repository types
summary: Test whether first-time adopters can follow the template in a CLI, a browser game, and a reusable toolkit using their actual entry points.

origin.source: README HQ portable guide and the project types used in its versioned archive.

benefits: Shows where the guide needs project-specific instructions for first success.
risks: A small sample can miss projects with unusual build or publication requirements.

evidence.claim: The guide lists first-action routes for games, CLIs, and templates.
AlderVale and BART provide two archived project examples.
